newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's EMU chances better than most - Dini.
newsitem.headline: Italy's EMU chances better than most - Dini.

text.p: Italy's chances of becoming a founder member of the European single currency are better than for many other EU countries, Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini said on Thursday.
Asked by reporters how he ranked Italy's chances of joining European economic and monetary union (EMU), Dini replied: "Excellent. Better today than that in many other countries."
Dini said Italy had already introduced numerous measures to ensure the deficit hits three percent of gross domestic product (GDP) as demanded by the Maastricht Treaty.
"Other countries have to introduce additional measures during the course of this year to get to the (three percent) level," Dini said.
Analysts say both France and Germany will miss the three percent target unless they introduce fresh budget measures.
